thread:
sam (customer-success): FYI we just had a P1 from AcmeRetail — intermittent 503s hitting their dedicated pool. They're asking for ETA & workaround. :warning:

maria (eng-platform): Noted. Any error patterns? p99/regions?

sam (customer-success): Errors are concentrated on pool-6 in us-west-2, spikes at ~30m intervals. First reported ~22:10 UTC. Stack trace shows routing fail -> 503 from router service.

kai (eng-runtime): Got logs from the caller path. Seeing KV cache pressure + transient worker OOMs for some models. Could be a batching surge causing worker churn.

maria (eng-platform): Who owns pool-6 routing config? I think that's jess. @jess pls confirm.

jess (eng-infra): I own the infra piece. I can check routing rules — nothing changed in config since last deploy. We did a scaling policy tweak earlier today tho.

aditya (oncall): I just pulled the alert. Temporal correlation with autoscaler scaling events at 22:08/22:36. When workers restart, router sometimes routes to draining nodes -> 503.

kai (eng-runtime): Workaround idea: short-term route away from pool-6 for AcmeRetail, i.e. add a routing override to send them to pool-4 (same HW profile) until we stabilize. Low risk, quick.

maria (eng-platform): Agree. Sam can we request that? Sam: confirm customer accepts temporary reroute + potential latency bump.

sam (customer-success): I pinged the customer — they accepted reroute if it avoids downtime. They prefer minimal latency impact.

jess (eng-infra): I can add override rule. Will need a quick ACL update and route table change. ETA ~12m if no permission blockers.

kai (eng-runtime): Also will open a hotfix PR to make router skip draining nodes in selection logic — small change: prefer state==ready && healthy. Need a code review + canary.

maria (eng-platform): Who can review the runtime PR fast? @kai assign to me + aditya.

aditya (oncall): I can review. If we land + canary, we should disable autoscale bursts for pool-6 temporarily to avoid churn. Jess, can you pin min_instances=3?

jess (eng-infra): Yes. I'll pin min_instances and add the override. Running commands now.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered — routing-override/acmeretail -> pool-4 (dry-run) by jess at 22:25 UTC

maria (eng-platform): After dry-run looks okay, promote to live. Kai please open the PR and link here. Also add a short regression test for draining node skip.

kai (eng-runtime): PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/runtime/pull/842 — small change + unit test. Marked urgent.

aditya (oncall): I'll canary the runtime change to pool-4 with 5% traffic for 10m after deploy. If p50/p99 stable, promote.

sam (customer-success): Customer confirmed reroute is live and 503s dropped. They're monitoring. Thanks team.

jess (eng-infra): Route override applied to AcmeRetail. Pinning min_instances=3 on pool-6. Observing for 15m.

kai (eng-runtime): Canary in progress. No errors so far in canary logs.

maria (eng-platform): Good. Follow-up action items: 1) Kai to merge PR & rollout permanent fix (owner: kai). 2) Jess to audit autoscale policy triggers (owner: jess). 3) Platform to add a routing fallback test in staging (owner: maria). 4) Sam to update customer timeline (owner: sam).

maria (eng-platform): Please reply with ETA for each?

kai (eng-runtime): PR review done, merging after CI. Expect merge + canary promote in ~25m.

jess (eng-infra): Autoscale audit started; will post findings in this thread by EOD PST. Quick fix ETA 2-4h if config changes needed.

sam (customer-success): I told the customer we'll follow up with permanent ETA after root cause. They've escalated to their ops team but are satisfied for now.

aditya (oncall): I'll keep monitoring pool metrics & set a temporary alert threshold to catch recurrence.

maria (eng-platform): Thanks all — keep updates here. If anyone needs an owner handoff, @maria will coordinate. :thumbsup:
